toni: Heads-up — onboarding edge sample (ESM) is triggering a TS inference collapse: generics passed to createClient get erased to `any` when the app uses `moduleResolution: \"bundler\"`. Runtime import is fine.

emma: can you paste a minimal repro + tsconfig?

toni: quick repro: 
```json
{
  \"compilerOptions\": {
    \"target\": \"ES2022\",
    \"module\": \"ESNext\",
    \"moduleResolution\": \"bundler\",
    \"lib\": [\"ES2022\", \"DOM\"],
    \"strict\": true
  }
}
```
and code: 
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-js'
const c = createClient<{viewer:{id:string}}>({})
// later: c.viewer.id is treated as `any` or produces type errors
```

ricardo: usual culprits: (1) exports/types mapping for the import entry is missing so TS flattens/chooses a different `.d.ts`; (2) a non-generic fallback overload (using `any`) is being selected during overload resolution; (3) conditional types widening to `unknown` because `globalThis.crypto.subtle` isn't available in some local dev envs.

emma: do we publish an `import.types` under `exports`? if not TS might pick a bundled `dist/esm` declaration that loses the generic-first signatures.

toni: we ship `main`, `module`, and `types` (dist/index.cjs, dist/index.mjs, dist/index.d.ts) but no `exports.import.types`. consumers using bundler resolution can hit a different declaration path.

ricardo: short-term sample workaround: add a local `types` shim in the sample package.json or use `typesVersions` to force the right d.ts. Ugly but unblocks customers.

emma: long-term fixes we should push: 
- add a types-only ESM declaration via `exports` (e.g. `exports.{\"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\", \"import.types\": \"./dist/index.mts.d.ts\"}`) so ESM consumers get an explicit typed entry.
- refactor `retry` / `authWrapper` / `createClient` overloads so the generic signature is primary and remove or constrain `any` fallbacks (prefer `unknown` + constraints).
- add an integration CI job that compiles the edge sample with `moduleResolution: bundler` and `skipLibCheck: false` to surface re-export/flattening regressions.

ricardo: also note: TS overload resolution will choose the first signature that matches. Emitted `.d.ts` order matters; ensure the generic variant is emitted first in the final declaration bundle.

toni: I'll draft a PR tonight that updates `exports` with an import.types entry and reorders/cleans overloads. I'll include a tiny repro under `devx/edge-typed-repro`.

emma: nice. add a short onboarding blurb about recommended tsconfig for Edge samples (moduleResolution: bundler, lib includes DOM for crypto types, and mention local node crypto shim). Include the temporary cast workaround in the README: `const c = createClient({}) as unknown as Client<{viewer:{id:string}}>` so users can continue while the fix lands.

devx-bot: Created issue devex/1501 (sdk: esm-type-inference-collapse) and assigned to toni.

ricardo: once PR is up I'll run the repro matrix across node/esbuild/bun and validate `skipLibCheck: false`. Also watch for downstream consumers that rely on the old fallback behavior.

toni: thanks all  assigning PR to me, CI test to ricardo, docs to emma. Will ping when ready for review. :thumbsup:
